name: London Project shared affiliate layout standard v3
selection_principles: Every article has exactly three verified provider buttons: Coupang Partners, Olive Young Global, Trip.com.
The ten product cards below the buttons are exclusively account-generated Coupang Partners offers.
Trip.com hotel, flight, and tours/packages links are separate tracked category links; copy account-generated URLs unchanged.
K-Trip365 requires two Coupang offers in each of five categories: beauty, electronics, health functional foods, Korea travel packages, Korea hotels.
Other sites use their own site-specific, topic-relevant pool of ten Coupang products.
Prioritize attractive but credible price points, sales/ranking signals and review evidence only when actually available.
Never invent products, images, tracking URLs, prices, or sales claims. Missing verified inventory blocks publication.
Preserve article body, publication status/date, featured image and SEO metadata; replace only the marked affiliate block.
Affiliate disclosure must be visible and all tracked links use sponsored nofollow noopener.
